capabilities: Search notes by keyword (BM25), vector, hybrid, or advanced queries
Show a related notes sidebar for the active note
Insert a search result as a wikilink into the current note
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. README includes detailed privacy disclosures: no network use, no clipboard access, no telemetry; the qmd index is stored outside the vault. Users must first install the QMD CLI and create a collection pointing at the vault folder.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search matches keywords only, so finding notes by meaning or similarity requires an external semantic search tool.

relations.evidence: It runs the local qmd command-line program on your machine

requires.name: QMD CLI (qmd binary on PATH or configured path)

summary: Local search plugin that runs the QMD CLI to search vault notes by keyword, meaning, or hybrid queries and show related notes.
